entities.summary: Monthly Comic Blade  was a Japanese shōnen manga magazine published by Mag Garden. It was first published in February 2002 and was sold on the 30 of each month until July 2014. It restarted in September 2014 as a free online magazine titled Online Magazine Comic Blade, which is updated on the 5, 15, 25 and 30 of each month. The manga series are published in tankōbon under the Blade Comics  imprint.
